verdict.rationale: Alloy's marketing describes Fraud Signal, its own machine-learning model, producing risk signals from customer data inside the product, plus 'agentic automation' for KYC/AML checks. That is a thin, glancing form of AI-derived insight. Nothing documents user-facing AI-generated insights, explanations or recommendations, and the evidence is homepage claims only. Missing for 10: documented AI-generated insights or suggestions surfaced to users, a description of how the ML or agentic outputs are presented, first-party docs beyond marketing copy, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Ditch static rules for Fraud Signal, our machine learning model that adapts as threats evolve
Streamline perpetual KYC/KYB, AML, and fraud checks with fully auditable agentic automation
Monitor your portfolio continuously with real-time risk signals
